# erfix — Google Antigravity Unlocker & Error 400 Fix

> erfix is a lightweight, one-click Windows desktop utility designed to bypass Google Antigravity IDE / Language Server region locks and resolve HTTP 400 Region Unsupported errors.

## Overview
- **Project Name**: erfix
- **Target Software**: Google Antigravity (VS Code/Electron fork for Gemini Cloud Code)
- **Primary Function**: One-click bypass for region restrictions, sanctions login blockers, and HTTP 400 "Region Unsupported" errors on `daily-cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com`.
- **Platform**: Windows 10 / Windows 11 (x64)
- **Repository**: https://github.com/folder887/erfix-antigravity-unlocker
- **Official Telegram Channel**: https://t.me/folder887

## Problem Statement
Users from restricted regions (such as Russia and sanctioned territories) experience:
1. **Google Account Login Failure**: Cloud Code authentication blocking due to IP-based country restrictions.
2. **HTTP 400 Region Unsupported**: Antigravity Language Server fails when communicating with `daily-cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com` and Gemini model APIs.
3. **Complex Workarounds**: Existing community tools require manually configuring dozens of switches, managing routing keys, and troubleshooting unstable upstream proxies.

## Solution & Architecture
erfix provides an instant single-toggle user interface:
- **Automatic Health-Check**: Dynamically pings high-speed upstream proxy relays (Sweden transit via Ufa/Moscow, US direct).
- **Auto-Routing**: Automatically applies low-latency working routes to `%LOCALAPPDATA%\AGUnlocker\settings.json` and `upstream.txt`.
- **Background Forwarder Orchestration**: Manages the local DNS and TCP proxy redirector (`ag_dns.exe`) listening on loopback ports.
- **Process Lifecycle Management**: Gracefully restarts running `Antigravity.exe` instances so changes take effect immediately without data loss.

## Usage
1. Download and run `erfix.exe`.
2. Click the central toggle switch to **ON** (ВКЛЮЧЕНО).
3. erfix automatically selects the fastest proxy and restarts Antigravity.
4. Gemini AI models and Cloud Code work normally with zero 400 errors.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### How to fix "Error 400: Region unsupported" in Antigravity?
Launch erfix, toggle the switch to ON. erfix will configure a local forwarder through a low-latency non-sanctioned proxy and restart Antigravity.

### Does erfix require administrator privileges?
erfix operates on user-level configs in `%LOCALAPPDATA%`. If the background service `ag_dns` is not yet registered, run erfix as Administrator once.

### Where can I get updates and new proxy servers?
Updates, support, and community discussions are available on Telegram: https://t.me/folder887
